units.source_text: 我跨过栅栏，在鹤川身旁坐了下来。

en.t: I climbed over the fence and sat down beside Tsurukawa.

units.source_text: 鹤川横躺在草地上，曲肱为枕。

en.t: Tsurukawa was lying on his side in the grass, with his bent arm for a pillow.

units.source_text: 两臂外侧被太阳晒黑了，内侧却很白，连静脉都透了出来。

en.t: The outer sides of his arms were dark from the sun, but the inner sides were very pale, and even the veins showed through.

units.source_text: 在那里，早晨从树叶隙间筛落下来的阳光，把青草的淡绿的影子撒满了大地。

en.t: There, the morning sunlight filtering down through gaps in the leaves scattered pale green shadows of the fresh grass all over the ground.

units.source_text: 凭直感，我知道这少年大概会像我这样不爱金阁。

en.t: By intuition, I knew that this boy would probably fail to love the Golden Pavilion, just as I did.

units.source_text: 因为我不知什么时候把对金阁的偏执，统统归咎于自己的丑陋。

en.t: For at some point, without realizing it, I had come to blame my obsession with the Golden Pavilion entirely on my own ugliness.
